evidence: In this work, nitrogen-doped TiO2 films were grown by atomic layer deposition (ALD) using TiCl4, NH3 and water as precursors. The reactor was operated under a pressure of about 10 mbar using nitrogen (made on site by a Nitrox UHPN 3000 generator, rated purity of 99.9995%) as a carrier and purging gas.
